speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a child experiencing frequent nosebleeds, bleeding from your mouth or gums, and small red spots on your skin called petechiae. To understand what is causing these issues, please tell me if you have had any recent infections, fever, or bruising on your body.

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old male. The child's parent reports that the child has been experiencing frequent episodes of nosebleeds and has had several instances of bleeding from the gums. Additionally, there have been occurrences of unexplained bruising and petechiae, primarily on the distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detailed history. Given the combination of frequent epistaxis, gum bleeding, and petechiae in a 4-year-old, I need to ask: has this child been diagnosed with leukemia or sickle cell disease, and are there any family members with bleeding disorders?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Frequent epistaxis. I also have Mucous membrane bleeding, Diffuse petechiae on distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP).
